import sys, json, random, subprocess, os

        skipped += 1; continue

        bad += 1
        print('MISMATCH trial', trial)
        a = json.dumps(got, indent=1, sort_keys=True).splitlines()
        b = json.dumps(exp, indent=1, sort_keys=True).splitlines()

        print('\n'.join(list(difflib.unified_diff(b,a,'exp','got'))[:70]))
